This is also in lint with the principle adopted by IEC/TC `50 `Environmental Testing' in developing unified series of standards on by International Electrotechaical environmenta! testing procedures Commission. 0.3 This standard ( Part 17 ) was originally published as IS :I2106 ( Part 17 j-1973* and subsequently redesignated as JS : 9000 ( Part 17/Set 1 )19731. This revision has been undertaken to line up this standard wiih the la:est International SFandards.
